To use this endpoint, youll need to generate an API key with the `sms.invalid_phone_numbers` permission.

- If you provide a `start_date`, an `end_date`, and `phone_numbers`, we prioritize the given phone numbers and disregard the date range.

> Use this endpoint to remove invalid phone numbers from Brazes invalid list. 
  

To use this endpoint, youll need to generate an API key with the `sms.invalid_phone_numbers.remove` permission.

This can be used to re-validate phone numbers after they have been marked as invalid.
